description: 해양수산부_지능형해양수산재난정보체계_VHFDSC정보 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 이 데이터는 VHFDSC 단말기를 장비한 선박에서 발생한 조난신호를 수집하여 선박의 안전 관리와 신속한 대응을 지원하기 위해 수집된 데이터입니다. 본 데이터의 주요 내용은 조난 단계, 조난 신호 발생 위치의 위도와 경도, 조난 신호를 보낸 어선 번호, 어선 식별용 MMSI번호, 조난 신호가 발생한 일시... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 조난정보, 선박, VHFDSC 통신망, 조난단계, 조난신호발생위치. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
